Screen specifications

Categories (do not to include descriptions)

Active & physical
Soft play, swimming/splash sessions, sports taster sessions, trampolining, climbing, martial arts, dance, gymnastics.

Creative & making
Arts & crafts, pottery/ceramics, cooking/baking, Lego/building, science & STEM workshops.

Performance & shows
Theatre & pantomime, cinema/film screenings, live music & singalongs, puppet shows, magic shows.

Learning & discovery
Museums & galleries (kids programmes), library sessions & story time, nature/wildlife, farm visits, workshops & talks.

Outdoor & seasonal
Parks & playgrounds events, forest school/outdoor play, festivals & fairs, seasonal events (Halloween, Christmas grottos, Easter egg hunts, summer holiday programmes).

Play & social
Baby & toddler groups, sensory play, play cafés, meetups & playdates, party venues.

Days out / attractions
Zoos & aquariums, adventure parks, indoor play centres, trampoline parks (overlaps with active — see note below)

Screen specifications

Date of event: Calendar picker

From: Time picker

To: Time picker

Occurance:

Weekly option would reveal day options, Monday to Sunday where the user can multi-select or deselect the relevant day/days.

Bi-Weekly similar to weekly but shows 2 weeks.

Custom:

Two dropdowns side by side. First dropdown user selects every X where X is a number, next dropdown options include Day, Week, Month. Week would reveal the same day options as the Weekly option. Monthly option would show days 1 to 28, where the user could multi-select or deselect.

If editing an event then there is a delete option

Behaviour

- When the end time has lapsed lets show the event as expired. After 3 days its automatically removed but remains in expired tab when signed in
